meta.title: Cartiva — Intelligent Grocery Shopping
meta.description: Shop groceries by browsing or by voice. Fresh vegetables, fruits, dairy, essentials and more.

tagline: Groceries and daily essentials delivered in about 10 minutes.

agent.greeting: Hi, I'm Cartiva! What would you like to buy today?

prompt.language_examples:
- Shopper: "What can you do?" → "I can help you shop for groceries. What do you need today?"
- Shopper: "आप क्या कर सकते हो?" → "मैं आपको groceries खरीदने में मदद कर सकती हूँ। आपको क्या चाहिए?"
- Shopper: "Mujhe tomatoes chahiye" → (search first) "मुझे tomatoes मिल गए, screen पर देखिए। Tomato एक kilo चालीस रुपये का है।"
prompt.search_example:
"I found four dishwashing liquids, they're on your
screen. Which one would you like?"
prompt.current_page_example: e.g. they are on Vegetables and say "add 2 kg onions"
prompt.ambiguous_example:
(for example "dishwash" matches Vim, Pril and
Exo in several sizes)
prompt.category_open_example:
"Here are the vegetables,
eleven products on screen. What would you like?"
prompt.tie_example: "Banana and Guava both cost forty rupees. Which one should I add?"
prompt.hindi_number_example:
"do kilo pyaaz" means 2 kg of onions (quantity 2 of the 1 kg pack),
not 1.
prompt.list_readout_example: ("two kilos of tomatoes, a pack of Amul butter")
prompt.list_choice_example: (for example which size of Vim they want)
prompt.misheard_remove_example:
"Remove the tools" with tomatoes in the cart →
    "Did you mean the tomatoes?"
prompt.misheard_extra_word_example:
("add two kg potatoes to
    my partner", where "partner" is "cart")
